Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, Idle State Group 1)
table.description: Target rail pressure by coolant in combustion mode 1, idle controller state group 1. Group 1: out of neutral, moving, or engine speed at or above a received idle-speed request; group 2: neutral (default state) or stopped below the request. On the manual car, probably without that request (inferred), group 1 = out of neutral and group 2 = neutral. Edit both together unless you know the difference. Combustion mode is the cold-start sequence: 0 cranking, 1 first warm-up phase, 2 stratified catalyst heating, 3 catalyst-heating phase 2, 4 normal running. Idle state groups: Group 1 is used out of neutral, while moving, or at or above a received idle-speed request; Group 2 in neutral (the default state) or stopped below that request. On this manual car probably in gear (Group 1) versus neutral (Group 2) (inferred). Identified from this ECU's code.
